newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK govt to resume Mong Kok sites for redevelopment.
newsitem.headline: HK govt to resume Mong Kok sites for redevelopment.

text.p: The Hong Kong government said on Friday it planned to resume some 1,082 sq. metres of land in one of the territory's older residential-commercial district.
The resumed land in Mong Kok on Kwoloon Peninsula would be used for redevelopment by the Land Development Corportation, it said in a statement.

The site would be developed as multi-storey commercial buildings with "government/institution/community" facilities including a public light bus terminus, a cooked food centre and neighbourhood community centres, the statement said.
